Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Reveal Line Ukrainian cultural collection courtyard source candidate, original project artwork, not a museum reconstruction.

Primary request: Create a separate revised version of this appealing 2:1 Poltava courtyard illustration. Correct the architectural details to be consistent with the textual description of the nineteenth-century Kuntseve house from Poltava region in the National Museum of Folk Architecture and Life of Ukraine. Preserve the continuous courtyard composition, generous straw roof, white clay-plastered house, late-summer light, orchard, wicker fence, wooden cart, baskets, clear foreground, and absence of people or lettering.
Required corrections:
1. Every visible window has exactly FOUR panes in a two-by-two arrangement and ONE hinged wooden shutter leaf total. Place that single full-width shutter visibly opened flat beside the window. The opposite side has only the ordinary narrow window frame: no second shutter, no pair, no ornamental shutter imitation. For clarity make the two main front windows large enough to read this single-leaf construction.
2. Remove every square projecting block bearing a flower, sunburst, star or geometric rosette. Replace them with a few restrained, small dark wooden longitudinal beam ends/upper-plate ends whose simple side silhouettes suggest the traditional carved horse-head motif. Keep the motif understated and structurally connected to the beams; do not add animal sculptures, symmetric heraldic crests, carved fascia lace or generic fantasy ornament. The exact historic carving is not established by this textual reference, so this is an original modest interpretation.
3. Rework the current large open through-gateway as a modest recessed household entry area with visible horizontal exposed dark logs at its front walls and a simple timber door. Keep two coherent inhabited house sections around an entrance zone; do not imply a grand ornamental gateway. No decorative square rosette brackets remain anywhere.
Style: Original pixel-art game-reward illustration with clear square clusters, stepped silhouettes and a consistent apparent pixel scale. Keep the existing restrained sky blue, golden straw, chalk white, warm earth and olive/indigo shadow. Avoid soft photographic texture, painterly blur, microtexture noise, decorative image borders and fake pixel filters.
Output: full opaque PNG, horizontal exactly2:1 composition, requested1152x576 pixels; actual dimensions will be recorded and a separate board derivative prepared later if required. No cropping of the scene. No text, logos, flags, symbols, UI, grids or watermarks.
Boundaries: This is a fictional regional courtyard informed by architectural text, not an exact Kuntseve site reproduction, not a museum-endorsed image and not production-approved artwork. Change the noted architecture while keeping the existing scene's general framing and quiet mood.
